comfort.validation_rule: Report baseline absolute nominal-band violations separately. Effective time-varying hard bounds are min(nominal lower, baseline lower) minus the screening tolerance and max(nominal upper, baseline upper) plus the screening tolerance. A response violation occurs only outside those effective bounds.

energyplus_control_translation.heating_reduction_action: for positive load-reduction offsets only, subtract offset from each referenced heating setpoint schedule; load-increase requests leave thermostat offsets at zero to preserve deadband
energyplus_control_translation.cooling_reduction_action: for positive load-reduction offsets only, add offset to each referenced cooling setpoint schedule; load-increase requests leave thermostat offsets at zero to preserve deadband
energyplus_control_translation.electric_equipment_action: multiply each indoor ElectricEquipment schedule by a clipped interval multiplier; the final schedule value is clipped to 0-1 inside EnergyPlus EMS
energyplus_control_translation.ems_schedule_sensor_alignment: Lead both control schedules by one 15-minute source interval, including preloading the preceding day's final interval, because BeginTimestepBeforePredictor schedule sensors produce a one-interval lag in the exported timestep results.
energyplus_control_translation.translation_rule: offset_c = clip(building_reduction_kw / baseline_portfolio_kw, 0, 1) * maximum_setpoint_shift_c so dual-setpoint deadbands are never contracted; equipment_multiplier = clip(1 - building_reduction_kw / (baseline_portfolio_kw * assumed_controllable_electric_fraction), minimum_multiplier, maximum_multiplier)

service_sign_convention: positive is net-load reduction; negative is net-load increase or renewable absorption
multiobjective_window_binding: When multiple ordered task families and the same number of windows are present, bind them positionally. A single shared window follows the first, explicitly highest-priority task family. Other mismatched family/window counts are rejected.
reactive_power_approximation: Finite-difference grid sensitivities assume flexible building power retains the original case33bw node Q/P ratio. Storage and PV are unity power factor in high-fidelity validation.
validation_policy: Every candidate schedule must be checked by nonlinear pandapower and EnergyPlus before release; linear RC-OPF feasibility is not final physical feasibility.
replanning_policy: After the first EnergyPlus replay, fix each zero-Severe, zero-response-comfort-violation BEM to its measured 96-interval response, set unsafe BEM building capacity to zero, and repair storage/grid dispatch. Do not discard safe building flexibility merely because another BEM failed comfort validation.

business_metrics.baseline_rule: Run a separate no-response nonlinear pandapower replay with the same background load, BEM baseline, PV, reactive-power convention, and operating day.
business_metrics.rebound_rule: Maximum positive response-minus-baseline feeder demand after the final active interval and before the end of the same operating day; null when the task occupies the full day.
business_metrics.flexibility_envelope_rule: For baseline-flexibility tasks, validate reduction and absorption directions separately. The reported bounds are target-BEM grid-interface net demand: counterfactual building demand minus validated downward service and plus validated upward service. A negative lower bound denotes permitted net export from BEM-connected storage, not negative building consumption.
business_metrics.renewable_absorption_rule: The signed request defines exogenous renewable energy that would otherwise be curtailed. Report remaining curtailment as requested absorption energy minus validated net-load increase, floored at zero. This is request-relative avoided curtailment, not curtailment inferred from unconstrained PV power flow.
business_metrics.market_settlement_rule: Simplified pay-as-bid settlement: validated delivered energy in market-bound intervals multiplied by the frozen offer price; the ISO-NE real-time LMP is reported as context and does not gate physical acceptance.
